claim: AWS is responsible for security of the cloud (the hardware, software, networking and facilities that run AWS services); the customer is responsible for security in the cloud, and how much the customer must configure depends on the services they select.
question: What is the one-sentence split of the shared responsibility model?

values.display: protecting the infrastructure that runs all of the services offered in the AWS Cloud
determined by the AWS Cloud services that a customer selects

evidence.quote: AWS is responsible for protecting the infrastructure that runs all of the services offered in the AWS Cloud. This infrastructure is composed of the hardware, software, networking, and facilities that run AWS Cloud services.

Customer responsibility will be determined by the AWS Cloud services that a customer selects. This determines the amount of configuration work the customer must perform as part of their security responsibilities.

claim: IAM Access Analyzer helps you reach least privilege with features to set, verify, and refine permissions: it analyzes external, internal, and unused access and validates that your IAM policies match your security standards.
question: What are the jobs of IAM Access Analyzer in one sentence?

values.display: analyzing external, internal, and unused access

evidence.quote: IAM Access Analyzer guides you to least privilege by providing features to set, verify, and refine permissions. It helps you implement your access management strategy by analyzing external, internal, and unused access, and validating that your IAM policies match your specified security standards.
